svg.title: Stacked bars: what happened to each family of attack
svg.text: Every attack family, and what happened to it
471 hostile attempts grouped by family. Bar length is the number of attempts; each new family is six commands tried three ways.
Sorted with the weakest result at the top, so the families worth arguing about come first.
